The idea

3A3D brings automotive browsing into a visual, editorial experience. The project combines a shared design system with a structured vehicle catalog.

What it explores

  • Vehicle and brand discovery
  • Search, filtering and sorting
  • Reusable templates and catalog data
BUILT WITH

HTML, CSS, JavaScript and a Python static-page generator.
